finding.claim: Admin.wipe discards the boolean result of requireRole, so any caller (including one with no OWNER role) reaches repo.wipe(tenant).
finding.source: Authenticated caller User u and the tenant path parameter of POST /tenants/{t}/wipe; precondition: caller can reach the route with any role set.

trace.note: Route comment: POST /tenants/{t}/wipe maps to wipe.
wipe(User u, String tenant) accepts caller and target tenant.
requireRole(u, "OWNER") called as a bare statement; return value unused.
requireRole returns u.roles().contains(role) and does not throw, so a missing role yields false with no effect.

finding.guards_checked: requireRole (src/Admin.java:14-16) is a pure predicate whose Javadoc says it does not throw; its return value is never read. No other guard, exception path, or tenant-membership check exists in wipe. Fix: use checkRole(u, "OWNER") as export does, or gate on the return value.

verdict.guard_found: None effective. requireRole (src/Admin.java:14-16) is a pure bool predicate whose result is discarded as a bare statement at src/Admin.java:26, so it never blocks. checkRole (src/Admin.java:18-22) throws, but it is not called in wipe. No other tenant-membership, role, or route-level check appears anywhere in the directory (Grep for wipe/requireRole/tenants found only src/Admin.java).
verdict.reason: Admin.wipe at src/Admin.java:26 calls requireRole without testing its boolean return, and requireRole (src/Admin.java:14-15) never throws, so repo.wipe(tenant) at src/Admin.java:27 runs for any caller who can reach the POST /tenants/{t}/wipe route regardless of OWNER role; the route wiring is not in the provided code, so reachability by low-privilege authenticated users rests on the route comment at src/Admin.java:24.

finding.claim: Admin.export checks the OWNER role but not that the role applies to the target tenant, so an OWNER of one tenant may export another tenant (candidate; depends on whether roles are global).
finding.source: Authenticated caller User u holding OWNER in some tenant, and an arbitrary tenant path parameter of POST /tenants/{t}/export.
finding.sink: repo.export(tenant) at src/Admin.java:33 (exports another tenant's data).

trace.note: export(User u, String tenant) accepts caller and target tenant.
checkRole(u, "OWNER") tests the role name only, not the tenant.
repo.export(tenant) runs for the supplied tenant.
User record has only name and roles, with no tenant field, so the check cannot be scoped to the target tenant.

finding.guards_checked: checkRole (src/Admin.java:18-22) correctly throws on a missing role, so the discarded-result bug does not apply. Not verified: how roles are assigned (global vs per-tenant) and how User is built from the request, since that code is not in this repo. Confidence low to medium.

verdict.guard_found: checkRole (src/Admin.java:18-22) throws on a missing role, so the discarded-result pattern does not apply. No tenant-scoping check exists between the caller and repo.export at src/Admin.java:33. The only other role check, requireRole (src/Admin.java:14-16), returns a bool and is not used in export.
verdict.reason: The trace matches the code: export at src/Admin.java:31-33 checks only the role name via checkRole (line 32) and passes the caller-supplied tenant to repo.export. Whether this is exploitable depends on whether roles are global or per-tenant, and User (src/Admin.java:4) is built outside this repo, so that cannot be settled from the code available.
